scripts.pack:all: yarn build && cd packages/core && yarn pack --filename flashcatcloud-miniprogram-core.tgz && cd ../miniprogram-core && yarn pack --filename flashcatcloud-miniprogram-platform.tgz && cd ../miniprogram-rum && yarn pack --filename flashcatcloud-miniprogram-rum.tgz
scripts.pack:local:
yarn build && mkdir -p dist && cd packages/core && yarn pack -o ../../dist/flashcatcloud-miniprogram-core.tgz && cd ../miniprogram-core && yarn pack -o ../../dist/flashcatcloud-miniprogram-platform.tgz && cd ../miniprogram-rum && yarn pack -o ../../dist/flashcatcloud-miniprogram-rum.tgz && echo '
✅ Packages built to dist/

Install in your miniprogram project:
  npm install /path/to/fc-sdk-wechat-miniprogram/dist/flashcatcloud-miniprogram-rum.tgz'
scripts.rum-events-format:sync: git submodule update --init && git submodule update --remote && node scripts/generate-schema-types.js
